newsitem.title: MALTA: Maltese hunger strikers stop protest against Hilton.
newsitem.headline: Maltese hunger strikers stop protest against Hilton.

text.p: Maltese environmentalists on Saturday said they would halt their hunger strike so as to give the government a chance to explain the decision behind allowing a Hilton hotel to be built on the outskirts of the capital.

The protesters -- who started with three people on Monday and were later joined by two others -- had argued the planned $100 million complex would harm the environment because the plans include a marina.
The planned hotel is owned by a group of Maltese businessmen.
Prime Minister Alfred Sant earlier in the week said he was ready to let the protesters look at the relevant documents concerning the transfer of land if the hunger strikers gave up their protest.
